headline: Mexican peso drops 4% to 19.16 per US dollar during foreign exchange volatility
summary: The Mexican peso depreciated 4% to touch 19.16 units per US dollar over the week, raising potential price pressures for domestic consumers.
why: The Mexican peso is one of the most liquid emerging market currencies. Exchange rate fluctuations influence import costs and inflation trends in Mexico.

impacts.name: Mexican Peso
impacts.why: The peso fell 4% against the US dollar to 19.16.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Currency market volatility drove a 4% decline in the Mexican peso against the US dollar.
